headlines.title: Trump Dismisses Dangers of AI: ‘The Whole Thing is a Hoax’
headlines.description: While most lawmakers are saying it’s time to enact guardrails against AI, President Donald Trump is continuing to downplay the potential dangers. In a surprise on-stage call to the head of Nvidia, Jensen Huang, the president said, “The robots will not be taking over…The whole thing is a hoax.” Instead, he’s framing the AI arms race as one to win. NBC’s Hallie Jackson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: FBI Director Kash Patel testifies at Senate hearing
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as FBI Director Kash Patel testifies at a Senate Judiciary Committee hearing.

headlines.title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump’s Bid to Restrict Mail-in Ballot Rules
headlines.description: The Supreme Court on Monday rejected President Donald Trump’s efforts to restrict mail-in voting ahead of the midterm elections in November. NBC’s Laura Jarrett joins TODAY to break down what’s at stake with the decision.

headlines.title: Pentagon inspector general says Iran war has led to a shortfall of U.S. munitions
headlines.description: It’s the first public report on the ongoing war started Feb. 28 by the U.S. and Israel.

headlines.title: Trump defends son over wedding party controversy
headlines.description: President Trump is defending his son Don, Jr. after a report suggested that a Russian man with links to Putin’s inner circle paid for a portion of his wedding party. NBC News’ Hallie Jackson reports.

headlines.title: Watch highlights of the 2026 Emmy Awards in 3 minutes
headlines.description: Apple TV's "Widow's Bay", "Pluribus," and HBO’s "The Pitt" received major awards at the 2026 Emmy Awards, with horror-comedy "Widow's Bay" taking home some of the night’s biggest awards, including outstanding comedy series, outstanding directing, outstanding lead actor Matthew Rhys, and outstanding supporting actress for Kate O’Flynn.

headlines.title: Emmys 2026 red carpet and winners: Matthew Rhys, Jean Smart, and more
headlines.description: On TV’s biggest night, the stars are coming out to shine.

headlines.title: The 2026 Emmys air tonight. Here’s what to expect, how to watch and who’s hosting.
headlines.description: Hollywood’s biggest night in television is back after a year of new beginnings. The 2026 Emmys will take place Monday, Sept. 14, at 8 p.m. ET.

headlines.title: Mitch McConnell Returns to the Senate After 3-Month Absence
headlines.description: Sen. Mitch McConnell returned to the Senate on Monday for the first time after a more than three-month departure. Arriving in a wheelchair, the 84-year-old cast his first vote, ending an absence that has fueled questions about his health. NBC’s Hallie Jackson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Harry and Meghan Change Kids’ School Over Security Concerns
headlines.description: A spokesperson for Prince Harry and Meghan Markle is confirming to NBC News that the couple’s children, 7-year-old Archie and 5-year-old Lilibet are changing schools after just two days due to security concerns. NBC’s Daniele Hamamdjian reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: EPA to repeal limits on greenhouse gas emissions from power plants
headlines.description: The move would overturn a 2024 Biden administration rule requiring power plants to control planet-warming pollution.

headlines.title: Harry and Meghan change their children’s school over security concerns
headlines.description: Archie and Lilibet, the children of Harry and Meghan, have changed school just days after starting, following security concerns about transporting them.
